history.content: Hi, my phone has no signal at all—nothing loads, no internet, and I can't send picture messages. It's completely dead network-wise.

Could you please provide one of the following:
- The phone number associated with your account
- Your customer ID
- Your full name and date of birth (for verification)

Once I have this information, I’ll begin diagnosing the problem.
My name is Sofia Martinez and my phone number is +1-617-555-0148.

Your line is currently suspended, which is why you have no signal, internet, or ability to send picture messages. The suspension is due to an overdue bill from January.

I have just sent you a payment request for the overdue amount of $65. Please check your payment requests and complete the payment. Once the bill is paid, I can help you restore your service. Let me know when you’ve completed the payment or if you need further assistance with the process.

history.content: My phone rebooted successfully, but the signal bars are still empty and I still have no service or internet.

Thank you for letting me know. Since your line is now active but you still have no signal or internet, let’s troubleshoot your device further.

Please check your phone’s status bar and let me know:
- Is Airplane Mode enabled?
- Do you see any signal bars at all, or does it say “No Signal”?
- Is there any indication of network type (e.g., 5G, 4G, LTE)?

If you’re able, please use your phone’s diagnostic feature to check the status bar and share what you see. This will help me guide you through the next steps.
Actually, I see excellent signal bars, 5G, data enabled, and it says I'm connected to Chestnut-5G in the status bar now.

Thank you for the update. Since you now see excellent signal bars, 5G, and data enabled, your cellular service appears to be restored. The “Chestnut-5G” indicates you are also connected to Wi-Fi.

To confirm everything is working:
- Can you make calls and send/receive regular text messages?
- Are you able to browse the internet with Wi-Fi turned off?
- Are you able to send and receive picture messages (MMS)?

If you still have issues with any of these, please specify which one so I can assist you further.
I just sent a picture message and it worked fine. I also turned off Wi-Fi and can browse the internet with excellent speed. Everything seems to be working perfectly now.

That’s great to hear! Your service, internet, and picture messaging are all working as expected now.

If you have any other questions or need assistance in the future, feel free to reach out. Have a wonderful day!
